title: The InnoGuide Podcast — Episode 100 Part Two book review of Incorruptible
summary: Bob Bouthillier closes his two-part Incorruptible review with episode 100 — the second half walks through what Ries calls organizational incoherence, the Culture Bank framing of every decision as a trust deposit or withdrawal, and the structural protections (Public Benefit Corporations, mission pledges, tenured voting, co-determination, ESOPs, spiritual holding companies) that hold a mission once the culture alone is not enough.
attribution_title: Innovation and entrepreneurship podcast hosted by Bob Bouthillier
